title: Economics of Information Search and Financial Misreporting

scopes.description: Complete supplied author workflow: SAS preparation imports and constructs the annual firm panel, exports main.dta, and Stata reads that intermediate for descriptive statistics, main regressions, and the final-sample CIK/fyear list.

requirements.description: Annual data.funda input used for firm characteristics, restatement outcomes, F-score and EPS-persistence construction; code filters FYR-positive observations with fyear 1980–2020 and needs the lag history used in those transformations.

routes.description: Frozen local candidate COMP.FUNDA is a merged annual fundamentals file. Its catalog schema omits conml, naics, ggroup, gind, gsector, and gsubind, which the supplied SAS directly selects from the annual source at lines 268–270; no earlier source-stage derivation supplies them. Candidate fields do not establish vendor-product absence. The author file's dates, population, and full required history are not verified.
routes.expected_period: The supplied source filter is fyear 1980–2020. Main-sample fiscal years 2005–2016 use one-year lead/lag construction, F-score fields from fyear−1 and fyear−2, and persistence regressions using fyear−9 through the current year (10 fiscal years); full population/history is unverified.

requirements.description: Quarterly input used to obtain fourth-quarter earnings announcement dates and prior-year quarterly dates; code filters FYR-positive observations with fyearq 1980–2020.

routes.description: Frozen local candidate COMP.FUNDQ lists the required fields and the bounded probe read one row. coverage_verified is false; product-period and complete history remain unverified.
routes.expected_period: Source filter fyearq 1980–2020; SAS uses fourth-quarter rdq and the previous fiscal-year fourth-quarter announcement date for matching annual observations.

requirements.description: Monthly security returns and prices are joined around fiscal dates for annual returns, volatility, price and buy-and-hold-return measures.

routes.description: Frozen local candidate CRSP.MSF lists permno, date, prc, and ret but not code-required ewretd, used directly in the excess-return calculation. Its field gap is specific to this catalog candidate and does not establish vendor-product absence.
routes.expected_period: No date filter is applied to the supplied monthly source. SAS uses monthly observations from 11 months before through the fiscal-date month for annual return/volatility, month-end prices at the fiscal date and 12 months earlier, and buy-and-hold returns from eight months before through three months after the fiscal date; coverage is unverified.

requirements.description: Daily prices/returns are joined at annual announcement dates and at the code's stated event-date windows.

routes.description: Frozen local candidate CRSP.DSF lists permno, date, prc, and ret but not code-required sprtrn, used directly in daily market-adjusted return construction. This candidate field gap does not establish vendor-product absence.
routes.expected_period: No date filter is applied to the supplied daily source. SAS requires daily observations at rdq−1 through rdq+1 weekdays, a price at one weekday before the prior-year rdq, and a price at one weekday before the fiscal-date minus nine-month anchor; history and coverage are unverified.

requirements.description: Link history maps Compustat GVKEY to PERMNO using LINKTYPE and LINKDT/LINKENDDT conditions in both annual and quarterly joins.

routes.description: Frozen local CRSP.CCMXPF_LINKTABLE lists the five required fields and the bounded probe read one row. SAS matches GVKEY to PERMNO using LINKTYPE and effective link dates; complete date-relative link history is unverified.
routes.expected_period: Link records must be active at each annual and quarterly Compustat datadate and satisfy the supplied LU/LC/LS link-type filter; complete history is unverified.

requirements.description: SAS derives restatement, HLM restatement, fraud and SEC-investigation indicators from this input and joins them by CIK/date.

routes.description: The frozen local AUDIT.FEED39_FINANCIAL_RESTATEMENTS candidate is a related Audit Analytics table, not the exact author alias. Its schema lacks res_sec_invest, res_acc_res_fkey_list, and res_notif_key, which the supplied code consumes directly; no equivalent derivation appears in this source stage. The candidate is not a complete route.
routes.expected_period: Author input alias is auditnonreli_95_20; SAS joins by CIK derived from company_fkey and measures current and lead-one event windows around fiscal datadate. Product/population and event-history coverage are unverified.

requirements.description: SAS imports the named restatement-data sheet, renames CIK_CODE and RESTATEMENT_KEY, and uses cumulative change in net income and disclosure date to construct the restatement amount.

routes.location: Audit Analytics supplemental workbook (author file AArestatementsJan2002toOct2020.xlsx)
routes.description: The named workbook is an external required input and is not packaged. SAS PROC IMPORT reads its restatement-data sheet, renames cik_code to cik and restatement_key to res_notif_key, then joins cumulative_change_in_net_income and disclosure_date by res_notif_key to construct restate_amt. The generated SAS dataset is not a separate raw input; compatible workbook availability and coverage remain unverified.
routes.expected_period: Author filename indicates January 2002–October 2020; SAS merges on the restatement notification key and uses the disclosure date. Workbook population and date coverage are unverified.

requirements.description: SAS selects FPI=1 forecasts before fiscal-period end, deduplicates by TICKER/FPEDATS and later consumes NUMEST.

routes.description: Frozen local IBES.STATSUM_EPSUS lists the required fields and the bounded probe read one row. coverage_verified is false; full product period and population remain unverified.
routes.expected_period: Author filename window January 1990–December 2019. SAS keeps FPI=1 forecasts with STATPERS before FPEDATS, then matches the historical ticker link active at STATPERS and uses NUMEST at the fiscal-period end date; history is unverified.

requirements.description: SAS matches each ticker/estimate date to its link-date interval and uses PERMNO plus SCORE for deduplication.

routes.description: Frozen local WRDSAPPS.IBCRSPHIST lists the required fields and the bounded probe read one row. coverage_verified is false; link-history coverage remains unverified.
routes.expected_period: Historical ticker-to-PERMNO link interval must be active at each I/B/E/S STATPERS; full interval history is unverified.

requirements.description: SAS constructs security/date ownership shares and institution counts from manager-level holdings.

routes.description: Frozen local TFN.S34 catalog metadata lists all five code-required fields. Its bounded one-row probe timed out after 15 seconds, so readability and coverage remain unverified; the timeout is not an access barrier.
routes.expected_period: Author filename window January 1995–December 2018; manager holdings are grouped by CUSIP/report date and matched at the fiscal datadate. Full population and history are unverified.

requirements.description: SAS creates month-end dates, joins by GVKEY/CIK and month, and scales shortintadj by shares outstanding.

routes.description: Frozen local COMP.SEC_SHORTINT lists gvkey, datadate, and shortintadj but not code-required cik, which the supplied SAS uses directly with gvkey in the join. The candidate schema cannot satisfy the authored identifier contract; this does not establish vendor-product absence.
routes.expected_period: Author filename window January 1990–August 2020; SAS matches by GVKEY, CIK, and the same calendar month as annual datadate, then scales shortintadj by shares outstanding. Candidate population/history are unverified.

requirements.description: This is a direct SAS input with no producer in the supplied SAS file; the code joins B_MKT by PERMNO/date to construct BETAff.

routes.location: WRDS Beta Suite daily prepared input (author file beta_d_FF3_Jan90_Dec19.sas7bdat)

routes.expected_period: Author filename window January 1990–December 2019; SAS joins at the code's weekday fiscal-date key. Source mapping, fields, and coverage are unverified.

requirements.description: SAS imports 15 yearly page-view files, concatenates them, joins by CIK/accession and aggregates DRTPV by CIK/date and filing form.

routes.location: James Ryan EDGAR page-view files alledgar2003.csv through alledgar2017.csv (author-stated download source)
routes.description: SAS imports 15 annual CSVs and consumes CIK, accession, date, and DRTPV before joining the SEC index. The author source and filenames are documented, but no file payload or exact compatibility metadata was obtained; the author URL fetch failure does not establish absence or access restrictions.
routes.expected_period: Author source names 2003–2017 annual files; SAS aggregates page views by CIK/date and joins filing forms. File schema, delivered period, and coverage are unverified.

requirements.description: The index supplies CIK, ACCESSION and FORM for the join to annual page-view records; code removes duplicate CIK/accession keys.

routes.location: SEC EDGAR index input edgar_daily_index.txt (author-documented download source)
routes.description: SAS imports a tab-delimited index and joins it to the annual page-view files by CIK/accession, using FORM to classify filings. The official SEC static page confirms an EDGAR log-file dataset period but does not establish this exact filename's schema or compatibility with the James Ryan files.
routes.expected_period: Must cover the filing keys joined to the author-named 2003–2017 annual page-view files; the datasheet reports a December 2020 SEC download. Exact period, file format, and key coverage are unverified.

issues.description: The frozen local candidates do not yet close several raw-source contracts: COMP.FUNDA lacks the directly selected raw fields conml, naics, ggroup, gind, gsector, and gsubind; CRSP.MSF lacks ewretd; CRSP.DSF lacks sprtrn; the related AUDIT.FEED39_FINANCIAL_RESTATEMENTS candidate lacks res_sec_invest, res_acc_res_fkey_list, and res_notif_key; and COMP.SEC_SHORTINT lacks cik, which the supplied join uses directly. Other bounded successful one-row reads show coverage_verified=false; TFN.S34's candidate field metadata lists its expected names but its 15-second readability probe timed out. These are candidate-level field/history/inspection gaps, not evidence that a vendor product or license is unavailable.

The supplied SAS directly reads a daily Beta Suite prepared file and joins B_MKT by PERMNO/date. The datasheet names WRDS Beta Suite, but the supplied package has no producer or raw-field mapping and exact frozen-catalog alias lookups did not establish a compatible route. The source/producer remains unknown; lookup results do not establish data absence or license status.

evidence.description: README documents the SAS preparation/export stage.
evidence.quote:
This document contains a brief description of the programs in the zip folder. The SAS and STATA programs
that take the raw data, create the final dataset, and produce the key results in the paper are compiled and
provided as “1_sas.sas” and “2_stata.do”. Each code performs the following data processing steps.



1. 1_sas.sas
(a) Imports raw datasets used in the analysis from sources described in item #2 of the data description sheet.
(b) Loads SAS macros used in the data processing.
(c) Creates key dependent variables and independent variables used in the analysis.
(d) Constructs the main dataset conditioning on sample period and variable availability.
(e) Exports the processed dataset to STATA.

evidence.description: README documents the Stata analysis and identifier export stage.
evidence.quote:
2. 2_stata.do
(a) Imports the processed dataset from SAS.
(b) Creates fixed effects.
(c) Checks descriptive statistics.
(d) Performs main analysis.
(d) Exports the identifiers of the observations that make up the final sample for the main analysis.

proc sql; create table dat5c as select a.*, 
b.epspx as epspx_lag1, b.prcc_f as prcc_f_lag1, c.prc as prcend, d.prc as prcbeg, e.b_mkt as betaff, f.prc as prcd_r, g.prc as prcd_y
from dat5b as a left join dat5a as b on a.cik=b.cik and a.fyear-1=b.fyear
left join msf as c on a.permno=c.permno and intnx('month',a.datadate,0,'end')=intnx('month',c.date,0,'end')
left join msf as d on a.permno=d.permno and intnx('month',a.datadate,-12,'end')=intnx('month',d.date,0,'end')

proc sql; create table dat7a as select unique a.*,
max(b.restate) as restate_lead1, max(b.restatehlm) as restatehlm_lead1, max(b.fraud) as fraud_lead1, max(b.sec) as sec_lead1, sum(b.restate_amt_adj) as restate_amt_adj_lead1
from dat7 as a left join restate4 as b on a.cik=b.cik
and ( (b.end>=intnx("month",a.datadate,+1,'beg')>=b.start) or 
  (b.end>=intnx("month",a.datadate,+12,'end')>=b.start) or 
  (intnx("month",a.datadate,+12,'end')>=b.end and b.start>=intnx("month",a.datadate,+1,'beg')))
group by a.cik,a.datadate; quit;
